question: Which active users have no recorded login or last logged in before the selected window?

steps.name: users
steps.soql: SELECT Id, Username, IsActive, UserType, LastLoginDate, CreatedDate FROM User WHERE IsActive = true AND (LastLoginDate = null OR LastLoginDate < LAST_N_DAYS:{days}) ORDER BY LastLoginDate ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT {limit}

verdicts.say: {users.rows} row(s) returned by the first query. Review selected columns, query limits and follow-up steps; this is not an org-wide assessment.

traps: LastLoginDate is a limited activity signal, not proof a user is unused.
A null login date can include newly provisioned users. No automatic deactivation is recommended.
